e.z: 飛機墜毀在茂密的叢林地區，無人生還。

e.e: A movie has been made about the last remaining survivor of the tribe.
e.z: 有一部電影是關於該部落最後一位倖存者的。

d.m: 易受外界影响的；易受感染的；容许…的

e.e: He's highly susceptible to flattery.
e.z: 他非常容易受奉承影響。

e.e: Some of these plants are more susceptible to frost damage than others.
e.z: 這些植物中有一些比其他植物更容易受到霜凍損害。

e.e: Salt intake may lead to raised blood pressure in susceptible adults.
e.z: 對於易受影響的成年人，鹽分攝取可能導致血壓升高。

e.e: There are few known diseases which are not susceptible to medical treatment.
e.z: 已知的疾病中，很少有不受醫療影響的。

e.e: She was both charming and susceptible.
e.z: 她既迷人又容易動心。

e.e: The restaurant is famous for its delicious sushi.
e.z: 那家餐厅以美味的寿司著名。

e.e: We tried eating sushi as an experiment.
e.z: 我们试尝一下寿司。

d.m: 幸免于难；存活；艰难度过

e.e: She was the last surviving member of the family.
e.z: 她是這個家族中最後一位倖存的成員。

e.e: Of the six people injured in the crash, only two survived.
e.z: 在這起車禍中受傷的六個人裡，只有兩個人活了下來。

e.e: The children had to survive by begging and stealing.
e.z: 孩子們不得不靠乞討和偷竊來生存。

e.e: Don't worry, it's only a scratch—you'll survive.
e.z: 別擔心，只是個小傷口——你會沒事的。

e.e: Some strange customs have survived from earlier times.
e.z: 一些奇怪的習俗從早期時代流傳了下來。

e.e: She was lucky to get off with a suspended sentence.
e.z: 她侥幸被判缓刑。

e.e: She was suspended from school for stealing.
e.z: 她因有偷窃行为遭勒令停学处分。

e.e: The judge gave him a nine-month suspended sentence.
e.z: 法官判处他9个月监禁，缓期执行。

e.e: A lamp was suspended from the ceiling.
e.z: 一盞燈從天花板上懸掛下來。

e.e: Her body was found suspended by a rope.
e.z: 她的屍體被發現用繩子吊著。

e.e: A boat was suspended on wires from the rafters.
e.z: 一艘船用金屬線懸掛在椽子上。

e.e: Production has been suspended while safety checks are carried out.
e.z: 在進行安全檢查期間，生產已暫停。

e.e: The constitution was suspended as the fighting grew worse.
e.z: 隨著戰鬥加劇，憲法被暫停實施。

e.e: I couldn't bear the suspense a moment longer.
e.z: 我再也無法忍受這種懸念了。

col.zh: 悬而未决；处于紧张等待状态

e.e: They were observing a suspected person.
e.z: 他们在监视可疑的人。

e.e: Two suspicious aspects are suspected respectively.
e.z: 两个可疑的方面分别受到怀疑。

e.e: The suspected spy was shadowed by detectives.
e.z: 那个有间谍嫌疑的人被侦探们跟踪。

e.e: As I had suspected all along, he was not a real policeman.
e.z: 正如我一直懷疑的那樣，他不是真正的警察。

e.e: If you suspect a gas leak, do not strike a match or even turn on an electric light.
e.z: 如果你懷疑有瓦斯洩漏，不要劃火柴，甚至不要打開電燈。

e.e: Suspecting nothing, he walked right into the trap.
e.z: 他毫無懷疑，直接走進了陷阱。

e.e: I didn’t want the neighbours suspecting anything.
e.z: 我不想讓鄰居懷疑任何事情。

e.e: I suspect (that) she might be lying.
e.z: 我懷疑（她）可能在說謊。

e.e: They became suspicious of his behaviour and contacted the police.
e.z: 他們開始懷疑他的行為，並聯繫了警方。

e.e: Police are not treating the fire as suspicious.
e.z: 警方不認為這場火災有可疑之處。

e.e: It might look suspicious if we arrived together.
e.z: 如果我們一起到達，可能會顯得很可疑。

e.e: I was suspicious of his motives.
e.z: 我懷疑他的動機。

e.e: Many were suspicious of reform.
e.z: 許多人對改革持懷疑態度。

e.e: I only had a little chocolate to sustain me on my walk.
e.z: 我走路時只有一點巧克力來維持體力。

e.e: The love and support of his family sustained him during his time in prison.
e.z: 家人的愛與支持在他坐牢期間支撐著他。

e.e: When she lost her job they could no longer sustain their expensive lifestyle.
e.z: 當她失業時，他們再也無法維持他們昂貴的生活方式。

e.e: The soil was so badly eroded it could no longer sustain crop production.
e.z: 土壤侵蝕得太嚴重，無法再維持作物生產。

e.e: She managed to sustain everyone's interest until the end of her speech.
e.z: 她設法讓每個人的興趣一直持續到演講結束。

e.e: He was arrested on suspicion of murder.
e.z: 他因涉嫌謀殺而被逮捕。

e.e: She was reluctant to voice her suspicions.
e.z: 她不願意說出她的懷疑。

e.e: His resignation seemed only to fuel suspicions.
e.z: 他的辭職似乎只會加劇懷疑。

e.e: It’s time to confront him with our suspicions.
e.z: 是時候向我們懷疑的人對質了。

e.e: I have a horrible suspicion that we've come to the wrong station.
e.z: 我有一種可怕的預感，我們來錯了車站。

e.e: The man looked at her suspiciously.
e.z: 那個男人懷疑地看著她。

e.e: Let me know if you see anyone acting suspiciously.
e.z: 如果你看到有人行為可疑，請告訴我。

e.e: Everything was suspiciously quiet.
e.z: 一切都異常安靜。

e.e: She eyed the fish on her plate suspiciously.
e.z: 她懷疑地看著盤子裡的魚。

e.e: Their latest single sounds suspiciously like the last one.
e.z: 他們的最新單曲聽起來和上一首可疑地相似。

d.m: 可持续的；合理利用的；养得起的

e.e: This type of farming is simply not sustainable any more.
e.z: 這種耕作方式根本無法再持續下去。

e.e: Unfortunately, this level of output is not sustainable.
e.z: 不幸的是，這種產量水準無法維持。

d.m: 燕子；吞咽；一次吞咽的量

e.e: Always chew food well before swallowing it.
e.z: 吞下食物前一定要充分咀嚼。

e.e: I had a sore throat and it hurt to swallow.
e.z: 我喉嚨痛，吞嚥時會痛。

e.e: The pills should be swallowed whole.
e.z: 這些藥丸應該整顆吞下。

e.e: I watched her walk down the road until she was swallowed by the darkness.
e.z: 我看著她沿著路走，直到她被黑暗吞沒。

e.e: Large areas of countryside have been swallowed up by towns.
e.z: 大片鄉村地區已被城鎮吞噬。

e.e: Exporting is necessary for our economic survival.
e.z: 出口對我們的經濟生存是必要的。

e.e: Continued trade in these products is a threat to the survival of the species.
e.z: 繼續交易這些產品對該物種的生存構成威脅。

e.e: The ceremony is a survival from pre-Christian times.
e.z: 這個儀式是基督教時代之前的遺存。

e.e: Loose your fist and put the swab on it for 15 minutes.
e.z: 请松开手,用棉签按压15分钟。

e.e: You should never put a cotten swap[cotton swab] or other object into the ear canal.
e.z: 你不应该放一根棉签或其他物体到耳道之中。

e.e: You should never put a cotton swab or other object into the ear canal.
e.z: 你绝不能把棉签或者其他小体积东西塞入耳道内。

d.m: 淹没；使陷于困境；使忙于应付

e.e: The country contains around 700 square km of swamp.
e.z: 這個國家有大約700平方公里的沼澤地。

e.e: Gnats came in swarms to torment them.
e.z: 蚊蟲成群結隊地來折磨他們。

e.e: The two players are appealing against their suspensions.
e.z: 這兩名球員正在對他們的禁賽處分提出上訴。

e.e: These events have led to the suspension of talks.
e.z: 這些事件導致了會談的中止。

e.e: Many movies require the viewer to engage in a willing suspension of disbelief.
e.z: 許多電影需要觀眾自願擱置懷疑。

e.e: The new model is fitted with computer-controlled suspension.
e.z: 新型號配備了電腦控制的懸吊系統。

e.e: The suspension was passed through a filter to separate out the solid particles.
e.z: 懸浮液經過過濾器以分離出固體顆粒。

d.m: 苍蝇拍；拍打者；强有力的击球手

e.e: She flipped at the fly with a swatter.
e.z: 她用苍蝇拍打那只苍蝇。

e.e: She fell over and swore loudly.
e.z: 她摔倒了，大聲咒罵。

e.e: I don't like to hear children swearing.
e.z: 我不喜歡聽到孩子們說髒話。

e.e: He heard her swear under her breath.
e.z: 他聽到她低聲咒罵。

e.e: He swore revenge on the man who had killed his father.
e.z: 他發誓要報復那個殺死他父親的人。

e.e: I swear (that) I’ll never leave you.
e.z: 我發誓（我）永遠不會離開你。

e.e: I swapped my red scarf for her blue one.
e.z: 我用我的紅圍巾換了她的藍圍巾。

e.e: I'll drive there and then we'll swap over on the way back.
e.z: 我會開車去那裡，然後回程時我們交換。

e.e: I think I'll swap this sweater for one in another colour.
e.z: 我想把這件毛衣換成另一種顏色的。

e.e: I'm going to swap you over. Mike will go first and Jon will go second.
e.z: 我要把你們交換一下。麥克先上，然後喬恩第二個上。

e.e: I'm perfectly happy—I wouldn't change places with anyone.
e.z: 我非常滿意——我不會和任何人交換位置。

e.e: The branches were swaying in the wind.
e.z: 樹枝在風中搖擺。

e.e: They danced rhythmically, swaying their hips to the music.
e.z: 他們有節奏地跳舞，隨著音樂搖擺臀部。

e.e: She wasn't swayed by his good looks or his clever talk.
e.z: 她沒有被他的英俊外表或花言巧語所動搖。

col.zh: 占主导地位；有支配力量

e.e: She wiped the sweat from her face.
e.z: 她擦去臉上的汗水。

e.e: By the end of the match, the sweat was pouring off him.
e.z: 比賽結束時，他汗流浹背。

e.e: Their bodies were soaked in sweat.
e.z: 他們的身體被汗水浸濕。

e.e: Growing your own vegetables sounds like a lot of sweat.
e.z: 自己種蔬菜聽起來很辛苦。

e.e: A lot of sweat has gone into producing this.
e.z: 為了生產這個，付出了很多心血。

e.e: I had a craving for something sweet.
e.z: 我很想吃點甜的東西。

e.e: This wine is too sweet for me.
e.z: 這酒對我來說太甜了。

e.e: I found the dessert a bit sweet for my taste.
e.z: 我覺得這道甜點對我來說有點太甜了。

e.e: The air was sweet with incense.
e.z: 空氣中瀰漫著焚香的甜味。

e.e: I can't tell you how sweet this victory is.
e.z: 我無法告訴你這場勝利有多甜美。

e.e: A black swan is rare.
e.z: 黑天鹅很稀有。

e.e: The swan sings when death comes.
e.z: 死期来到，天鹅歌声美妙。

e.e: The witch turned the princess into a swan.
e.z: 巫婆把公主变成了一只天鹅。

e.e: He was attracted to her sweetness and innocence.
e.z: 他被她的甜美和天真所吸引。

e.e: The air was filled with the sweetness of mimosa.
e.z: 空氣中充滿了含羞草的香氣。

e.e: I can’t complain—he’s been all sweetness and light with me.
e.z: 我沒什麼好抱怨的——他對我總是和藹可親。

e.e: People think she's all sweetness and light, but she actually has a temper.
e.z: 人們認為她總是和藹可親，但她其實有脾氣。

e.e: It’s not all sweetness and light being an actor.
e.z: 當演員並不總是那麼美好。

e.e: It was all carried out without any consideration for the susceptibilities of the bereaved family.
e.z: 這一切都是在完全沒有考慮到家屬感受的情況下進行的。

e.e: Milky tea sweetened with honey is my four o'clock treat.
e.z: 用蜂蜜調味的奶茶是我下午四點的點心時間。

e.e: You're always trying to sweeten her up.
e.z: 你總是想討好她。

e.e: The fall in inflation did little to sweeten news of massive job losses.
e.z: 通貨膨脹率下降並未緩和大規模裁員的消息所帶來的衝擊。

e.e: Sweeten up your day with one of these mouth-watering desserts.
e.z: 用這些令人垂涎的甜點來點亮你的一天吧。

col.zh: 使交易更诱人；增加好处

d.m: 突然转向；转弯；偏离方向

e.e: She swerved sharply to avoid a cyclist.
e.z: 她突然急轉彎以避開一名騎自行車的人。

e.e: The bus suddenly swerved into his path.
e.z: 公車突然轉向他的行駛路線。

e.e: The ball swerved into the net.
e.z: 球轉彎飛進了球門。

e.e: He rose to his feet in one swift movement.
e.z: 他以一個迅速的動作站了起來。

e.e: The White House was swift to deny the rumours.
e.z: 白宮迅速否認了這些謠言。

e.e: She wore jeans and a sweater.
e.z: 她穿著牛仔褲和一件毛衣。

e.e: He was wearing a cashmere sweater over his shirt.
e.z: 他在襯衫外面穿了一件喀什米爾毛衣。

e.e: She has knitted me beautiful sweaters and socks.
e.z: 她為我織了漂亮的毛衣和襪子。

e.e: The boys swam across the lake.
e.z: 男孩們游過了湖。

e.e: They spent the day swimming and sunbathing.
e.z: 他們一整天都在游泳和曬太陽。

e.e: I've only just learned to swim.
e.z: 我才剛學會游泳。

e.e: I have always found it easy to swim underwater.
e.z: 我一直覺得在水下游泳很容易。

e.e: They are too far out to swim to shore.
e.z: 他們離岸邊太遠，游不回去。

e.e: He moved with surprising swiftness for someone who had just woken up.
e.z: 對於一個剛醒來的人來說，他的動作快得驚人。

e.e: These technological changes happened with astonishing swiftness.
e.z: 這些技術變革以驚人的速度發生。

e.e: She looked surprisingly well.
e.z: 她看起來出奇地健康。

e.e: Surprisingly, he agreed straight away.
e.z: 令人驚訝的是，他立刻就同意了。

e.e: She knew surprisingly little about her sister’s life.
e.z: 她對姐姐的生活了解得少得驚人。

e.e: Chimneys should be swept regularly.
e.z: 煙囪應該定期清掃。

e.e: I don't have to sweep and mop every day.
e.z: 我不需要每天掃地和拖地。

e.e: Don't just stand around—grab a broom and sweep up.
e.z: 別只是站在那裡——拿把掃帚打掃乾淨。

e.e: The showroom had been emptied and swept clean.
e.z: 展示廳已經被清空並打掃乾淨。

e.e: She swept the crumbs into the wastebasket.
e.z: 她把碎屑掃進了廢紙簍。

e.e: Financial sweeteners were used to secure the deal.
e.z: 為了促成這筆交易，使用了金錢誘因。

e.e: Landowners were offered up to £150 000 in sweeteners to allow the masts to be sited on their land.
e.z: 地主們被提供高達15萬英鎊的誘因，以允許在他們的土地上架設天線桿。

e.e: Workers in the public sector have benefited from pre-election sweeteners.
e.z: 公共部門的員工因選前的好處而受益。

e.e: She moved swiftly to the rescue.
e.z: 她迅速趕去救援。

e.e: Surprise was swiftly followed by outrage.
e.z: 驚訝之後緊接著是憤怒。

e.e: Swimming is a good form of exercise.
e.z: 游泳是一種很好的運動方式。

e.e: The car can be a swine to start.
e.z: 這輛車可能很難發動。

e.e: A set of keys swung from her belt.
e.z: 一串鑰匙從她的腰帶上晃來晃去。

e.e: He sat on the stool, swinging his legs.
e.z: 他坐在凳子上，晃著雙腿。

e.e: The gunshot sent monkeys swinging away through the trees.
e.z: 槍聲讓猴子們盪著樹枝逃走了。

e.e: He swung himself out of the car.
e.z: 他從車裡一躍而出。

e.e: A line of cars swung out of the palace gates.
e.z: 一列汽車從宮殿大門駛出。

e.e: The water swirled down the drain.
e.z: 水旋轉著流進排水管。

e.e: A long skirt swirled around her ankles.
e.z: 一條長裙在她腳踝周圍旋轉。

e.e: He took a mouthful of water and swirled it around his mouth.
e.z: 他喝了一口水，在嘴裡漱了漱。

e.e: You are wearing a very beautiful swimsuit.
e.z: 你身上穿的那件泳衣好漂亮。

e.e: Remember to wring your swimsuit out after you swim.
e.z: 记住游泳过后要把游泳衣拧干。

e.e: Bring your swimsuit because you might want to swim in the sea.
e.z: 带上游泳衣，说不定你会想去海里游泳呢。

e.e: Her eyes were red and swollen from crying.
e.z: 她的眼睛因哭泣而紅腫。

e.e: The swivel had been oiled to perfection.
e.z: 旋轴已经上足了油。

e.e: She returned to the swivel chair behind her desk.
e.z: 她回到桌子后面的转椅上。

e.e: She swivelled the telescope (round).
e.z: 她用望远镜向四周看。

d.m: 重击；猛打；<非正式>尖刻的评论

e.e: He swiped at the ball and missed.
e.z: 他揮棒擊球，但沒打中。

e.e: They’re always swiping other kids’ sweets.
e.z: 他們總是偷拿其他小孩的糖果。

e.e: The cash register only opens once the card has been swiped.
e.z: 收銀機只有在卡片刷過後才會打開。

e.e: Switch on the phone and swipe your finger across the screen to unlock it.
e.z: 打開手機，用手指滑過螢幕來解鎖。

e.e: Her arm was beginning to swell up where the bee had stung her.
e.z: 她的手臂被蜜蜂螫到的地方開始腫起來。

e.e: Bacteria can cause gums to swell and bleed.
e.z: 細菌會導致牙齦腫脹和出血。

e.e: Cook the lentils for 20 minutes until they swell and soften.
e.z: 將扁豆煮20分鐘，直到它們膨脹變軟。

e.e: The sails swelled (out) in the wind.
e.z: 帆在風中鼓了起來。

e.e: His belly swelled out over his belt.
e.z: 他的肚子鼓出了皮帶。

e.e: The aircraft swooped down over the buildings.
e.z: 飛機俯衝到建築物上方。

e.e: A hawk swooped low over the field.
e.z: 一隻鷹低飛掠過田野。

e.e: Officers swooped on the vehicles as they left the ferry.
e.z: 警察在車輛離開渡輪時突襲了它們。

e.e: Customs officers swooped on several houses last night looking for drugs.
e.z: 海關官員昨晚突襲了幾間房子，尋找毒品。

e.e: Fame is a double-edged sword.
e.z: 名聲是一把雙刃劍。

e.e: All the men were put to the sword.
e.z: 所有男人都被處死了。

e.e: They swindled him out of hundreds of dollars.

e.z: 她的嘴唇因覺得好笑而抽動。

e.e: The cats watched each other, their tails twitching.
e.z: 貓咪們互相盯著，尾巴抽動著。

e.e: The animal lay on the ground, its whole body twitching and jerking.
e.z: 那隻動物躺在地上，全身抽搐顫動。

e.e: He twitched the package out of my hands.
e.z: 他從我手中一把奪走包裹。

e.e: Mark twitched the cigarette from his mouth.
e.z: 馬克從嘴裡抽走香菸。

e.e: His home was destroyed in a typhoon.
e.z: 他的家在一場颱風中被摧毀。

e.e: Bungalows are a type of house.
e.z: 平房是房屋的一種類型。

e.e: There are three main types of contract(s).
e.z: 合約主要有三種類型。

e.e: She mixes with people of all types.
e.z: 她與各種類型的人交往。

e.e: It is the first car of its type to have this design feature.
e.z: 這是同類型汽車中第一款具備此設計特色的。

e.e: He's not the type to be unfaithful.
e.z: 他不是那種會不忠的人。

e.e: Elaine plucked a twig from the offending japonica and set about its systematic defoliation with savage concentration.
e.z: 埃莱恩从难看的山茶上折了个嫩枝，开始猛烈的收集系统的落叶。

d.m: 典型地；代表性地；通常，一般

e.e: Generating solar power has typically involved higher capital costs.
e.z: 太陽能發電通常涉及較高的資本成本。

e.e: The Bengal tiger is typically found in the forests of Central and Southern India.
e.z: 孟加拉虎通常分布在印度中部和南部的森林中。

e.e: The factory typically produces 500 chairs a week.
e.z: 這家工廠通常每週生產500張椅子。

e.e: A typically priced meal will be around $10.
e.z: 一頓飯的典型價格大約是10美元。

e.e: Typically, the contracts were for five years.
e.z: 通常，這些合約為期五年。

e.e: Her eyes twinkled with merriment.
e.z: 她的眼睛閃爍著歡樂的光芒。

e.e: His mother twinkled at him over her teacup.
e.z: 他母親隔著茶杯對他微笑眨眼。

col.zh: 眼中闪烁的光芒（指幽默或调皮的神情）

e.e: The letter had been written on an old typewriter.
e.z: 這封信是用一台舊打字機打的。

e.e: I'm 5 months pregnant with twins.
e.z: 我懷了雙胞胎，已經五個月了。

e.e: The plate was one of a pair but I broke its twin.
e.z: 這個盤子本來是一對的，但我打破了它的另一個。

e.e: She worked as a typist in a law firm.
e.z: 她在一家律师事务所当打字员。

e.e: Our typist is away on holiday this week.
e.z: 我们这儿的打字员这星期因休假没上班。

e.e: So a lie, or a mistake, or a typo, can be amplified and streamlined and then beamed into every home in a matter of seconds, all thanks to the wonderful power of the Interweb.
e.z: 真要感谢功能强大的互联网，它使得一个谎言，一条误传，甚至一个排版错误都可能被放大，并瞬间传遍全世界。

e.e: The twister, reported to be about 100 yards wide, caused major damage to the high school.
e.z: 據報導約100碼寬的龍捲風，對高中造成了嚴重破壞。

d.m: 作为某人或某物的典型；代表；象征

e.e: Now a millionaire, he typifies the self-made man.
e.z: 他成了百万富翁，可以说是白手起家的典型。

e.e: The nurses' strike typifies public concern about our hospitals.
e.z: 这次护士罢工集中地反映出公众对医疗事业的关心。

e.e: The haunting guitar melodies typify the band's music.
e.z: 那萦绕于心头的吉他旋律象征了这个乐队的音乐。

e.e: Companies must not be allowed to exploit and tyrannize employees made desperate by economic collapse.
e.z: 不能允許公司剝削和壓迫那些因經濟崩潰而絕望的員工。

e.e: Since he took power five years ago, he has tyrannized over the people of this small nation.
e.z: 自從他五年前掌權以來，他一直對這個小國的人民施行暴政。

e.e: There are only two cookies left.
e.z: 只剩下兩塊餅乾了。

e.e: Ten people were invited but only two turned up.
e.z: 邀請了十個人，但只有兩個人到場。

e.e: She's in two minds about accepting his invitation.
e.z: 她對於是否接受他的邀請猶豫不決。

e.e: He broke the bar of chocolate in two and gave me half.
e.z: 他把巧克力棒掰成兩半，給了我一半。

e.e: People arrived in twos and threes.
e.z: 人們三三兩兩地到來。

d.m: 暴君；专制的君主；专横的人

e.e: The country was ruled by a succession of tyrants.
e.z: 這個國家被一連串的暴君統治。

e.e: His boss is a complete tyrant.
e.z: 他的老闆完全是個暴君。

e.e: The calf fumbled for its mother's udder for milk.
e.z: 小牛摸索着妈妈的乳房找奶吃。

e.e: A cow's udder hangs loosely between its legs and produces milk.
e.z: 母牛的乳房垂於腿之间用来产奶。

e.e: Dolly was the only lamb born from 277 fusions of oocytes with udder cells.
e.z: 多利是277组卵母细胞和乳腺细胞的配对中唯一克隆成活的。

e.e: Look at the growing ubiquity of WiFi to illustrate this.
e.z: 用增长中的到处存在的无线局域网来举例说明一下。

d.m: 丑陋的；难看的；令人困窘的

e.e: The witch was hideously ugly.
e.z: 那個女巫長得極其醜陋。

e.e: There were ugly scenes in the streets last night as rioting continued.
e.z: 昨晚街頭因持續的暴動而出現了混亂的場面。

e.e: Very quickly, the mood turned ugly.
e.z: 氣氛很快就變得惡劣起來。

col.zh: 丑小鸭（指大器晚成的人）

e.e: The children had no protection against the tyranny of their father.
e.z: 孩子們無法抵禦父親的專制暴虐。

e.e: These days it seems we must all submit to the tyranny of the motor car.
e.z: 如今，我們似乎都必須屈服於汽車的霸道。

e.e: Any political system refusing to allow dissent becomes a tyranny.
e.z: 任何拒絕容忍異議的政治體制都會變成獨裁統治。

d.m: 特有的；典型的；有代表性的

e.e: This is a typical example of Roman pottery.
e.z: 這是羅馬陶器的典型範例。

e.e: Judy is a typical American teenager.
e.z: 茱蒂是典型的美國青少年。

e.e: This meal is typical of local cookery.
e.z: 這頓飯是當地烹飪的典型代表。

e.e: The weather at the moment is not typical for July.
e.z: 目前的天氣對七月來說並不典型。

e.e: A typical working day for me begins at 7.30.
e.z: 我典型的工作日從早上7點30分開始。

e.e: He could see the ubiquitous TV cameras.
e.z: 他可以看到那些无处不在的电视摄像机。

e.e: The struggle between opposites is ubiquitous.
e.z: 对立的争斗无所不在。

e.e: Happiness is ubiquitous, may fall short of demand.
e.z: 幸福无处不在

e.e: He is ultimately responsible for the actions of the rebels he leads.
e.z: 他對他領導的叛亂分子的行為負有最終責任。

e.e: Ultimately, you'll have to make the decision yourself.
e.z: 最終，你必須自己做出決定。

e.e: His strategy ultimately failed, however.
e.z: 然而，他的策略最終失敗了。

e.e: Smith ultimately became the father of modern geology.
e.z: 史密斯最終成為現代地質學之父。

e.e: The economic changes ultimately proved successful.
e.z: 這些經濟變革最終證明是成功的。

e.e: There is a family history of gastric ulcer disease.
e.z: 有胃潰瘍疾病的家族史。

d.m: 隐秘的；别有用心的；将来的

e.e: This lever must serve some ulterior purpose.
e.z: 这撬棒准是用于不可告人的目的的。

e.e: There was no ulterior motive in his proposal.
e.z: 他的建议里没有不可告人的动机。

e.e: I want to know what is our ulterior action.
e.z: 我想要知道下一步的行动是什么。

d.m: 同时普遍存在的(处处存在的；随遇的)

e.e: Tourist buses are immediately and ubiquitously available.
e.z: 觀光巴士隨處可見，隨時可得。

e.e: The umpire’s decision is final.
e.z: 裁判的決定是最終的。

e.e: Umami is the savoury taste known as the ‘fifth taste’.
e.z: 鮮味是被称为「第五味」的鹹味。

e.e: They danced all night with unabated energy.
e.z: 他們以不減的精力跳了一整夜的舞。

e.e: Spectators huddled under umbrellas as the rain poured down.
e.z: 大雨傾盆而下，觀眾們擠在雨傘下。

e.e: Many previously separate groups are now operating under the umbrella of a single authority.
e.z: 許多原本各自獨立的團體，現在都在一個單一權威的架構下運作。

e.e: The ozone layer shields the earth from the sun's ultraviolet rays.
e.z: 臭氧层保护地球不受太阳紫外线的辐射。

e.e: A suncream provides adequate protection against harmful ultraviolet rays.
e.z: 使用防晒霜可以保护皮肤不受紫外线的伤害。

e.e: Ultraviolet rays can penetrate through clouds.
e.z: 紫外线可以穿透云层。

e.e: We will accept ultimate responsibility for whatever happens.
e.z: 無論發生什麼事，我們都將承擔最終責任。

e.e: The ultimate decision lies with the parents.
e.z: 最終的決定權在父母手中。

e.e: This race will be the ultimate test of your skill.
e.z: 這場比賽將是對你技巧的終極考驗。

e.e: Silk sheets are the ultimate luxury.
e.z: 絲質床單是終極的奢華享受。

e.e: Nuclear weapons are the ultimate deterrent.
e.z: 核武器是最終的威懾力量。

d.m: 没有装饰的；不加渲染的；朴素的

e.e: The walls were plain and unadorned.
e.z: 牆壁樸素無華。

e.e: The story is recounted in her usual unadorned style.
e.z: 這個故事是以她一貫不加修飾的風格敘述的。

d.m: 不能接受的；不受欢迎的

e.e: Such behaviour is totally unacceptable in a civilized society.
e.z: 這種行為在文明社會中是完全無法接受的。

e.e: Noise from the factory has reached an unacceptable level.
e.z: 工廠的噪音已達到無法接受的程度。

d.m: (信等)不写姓名地址的；无姓名地址的
无法解释的；不能理解的；不负责任的

e.e: There has been an unaccountable increase in cases of the disease.
e.z: 這種疾病的病例出現了無法解釋的增加。

e.e: For some unaccountable reason, the letter never arrived.
e.z: 由於某種無法解釋的原因，那封信從未送達。

e.e: Too many government departments are unaccountable to the general public.
e.z: 太多政府部門對一般大眾不負責任。

e.e: Photographs can show things invisible to the unaided eye.
e.z: 照片可以顯示肉眼看不見的東西。

e.e: Apartheid is absolutely unambiguous.
e.z: 种族隔离绝对不是含糊的。

e.e: The descriptions should be precise and unambiguous.
e.z: 描述应该是精确和无歧义的。

e.e: Truth is unalterable, eternal and unambiguous.
e.z: 真理是不变的、永恒的、毫不隐诲的。

syn.m: 不侵略的, 不侵犯的...

e.e: The motion was passed unanimously.
e.z: 該動議獲得一致通過。

e.e: The resolution was unanimously rejected.
e.z: 該決議被一致否決。

d.m: 无搀杂的；纯粹的；完全的

e.e: For me, the holiday was sheer unadulterated pleasure.
e.z: 對我來說，這個假期是純粹的、不摻雜質的快樂。

d.m: 不羞耻的；厚脸无耻的；无愧的

e.e: She talked openly about her unashamed love of money.
e.z: 她公開談論自己對金錢毫不掩飾的熱愛。

e.e: She would have been quite unashamed if anyone had caught her.
e.z: 即使有人抓到她，她也會毫不在乎。

d.m: 全体一致的；一致同意的

e.e: The decision was not unanimous.
e.z: 這個決定並非一致通過。

e.e: Unanimous agreement must be reached for this plan to go ahead.
e.z: 這個計劃要進行，必須達成一致的協議。

e.e: The jury reached a unanimous verdict of ‘not guilty’.
e.z: 陪審團達成一致裁決，判定「無罪」。

e.e: She was the unanimous choice of the selection committee.
e.z: 她是甄選委員會一致選擇的人選。

e.e: Local people are unanimous in their opposition to the proposed new road.
e.z: 當地居民一致反對擬議中的新道路。

d.m: 无关系的；非附属的；未订婚的

e.e: He was still unattached at the age of 34.
e.z: 他34歲時仍然單身未婚。

e.e: Many of the problems were caused by the unavailability of suitable equipment.
e.z: 許多問題是由於缺乏合適設備所導致的。

e.e: The trial was adjourned due to the unavailability of a key witness.
e.z: 審判因關鍵證人無法到場而延期。

d.m: 未经授权的；未经批准的

e.e: No access for unauthorized personnel.
e.z: 未經授權人員不得進入。

d.m: 无伴侣的；不伴随的；无伴奏的

e.e: No unaccompanied children allowed.
e.z: 禁止無成人陪同的兒童進入。

e.e: Mere words, unaccompanied by any violence, cannot amount to an assault.
e.z: 單純的言語，若無任何暴力行為，不能構成攻擊。

e.e: He was completely unaware of the whole affair.
e.z: 他對整件事完全不知情。

e.e: She was unaware that I could see her.
e.z: 她不知道我能看見她。

e.e: We get through an unbelievable amount of food each week.
e.z: 我們每週消耗的食物量驚人。

e.e: I found the whole story bizarre, not to say unbelievable.
e.z: 我覺得整個故事離奇，甚至可說難以置信。

d.m: 未被打破的或击败的；未被践踏的；（烹调中）未被搅拌的

e.e: The team are unbeaten in their last four games.
e.z: 這支球隊在最近四場比賽中保持不敗。

e.e: Recession at the time seemed unavoidable.
e.z: 當時的經濟衰退似乎無可避免。

e.e: Nowadays, with the rapid development of modern cities, many conflicts unavoidably occur between city modernization and historic cultural landscape conservation.
e.z: 摘要当前，在城市化急速发展的背景下，城市现代化建设同历史文化保护之间不可避免地存在着许多矛盾。

e.e: Unbelievably it actually works.
e.z: 令人難以置信的是，它竟然真的有效。

d.m: 不间断的；未破的；未驯服的

e.e: Silence reigned unbroken in the room.
e.z: 房間內一片寂靜，毫無聲響。

e.e: His long jump record remained unbroken for 25 years.
e.z: 他的跳遠紀錄保持了25年未被打破。

e.e: He lay there, unable to move.
e.z: 他躺在那裡，動彈不得。

e.e: I tried to contact him but was unable to.
e.z: 我試著聯絡他，但沒能成功。

e.e: I am afraid I am unable to provide the information you have requested.
e.z: 恐怕我無法提供您所要求的資訊。

e.e: She was unable to hide her excitement.
e.z: 她無法隱藏自己的興奮。

e.e: Let us know if you’re unable to come.
e.z: 如果您無法前來，請告訴我們。

e.e: The witness is unbiased and so reliable.
e.z: 那个证人没有偏见, 因而是可靠的。

e.e: The credit rating agency shall ensure its rating unbiased and fair.
e.z: 资信评级机构应保证其信用评级客观公正。

e.e: He had an unblemished reputation.
e.z: 他擁有無可挑剔的名聲。

e.e: I had an uncanny feeling I was being watched.
e.z: 我有種詭異的感覺，好像被監視著。

e.e: It was uncanny really, almost as if she knew what I was thinking.
e.z: 這真的很詭異，幾乎就像她知道我在想什麼。

e.e: He has an uncanny knack of being able to see immediately where the problem lies.
e.z: 他有一種神奇的直覺，能立刻看出問題所在。

e.e: She bore a quite uncanny resemblance to my Auntie Elsie.
e.z: 她長得跟我艾爾西阿姨驚人地相似。

d.m: 不确定的；不稳定的；易变的

e.e: They're both uncertain about what to do.
e.z: 他們兩人都對該做什麼感到不確定。

e.e: I'm still uncertain of my feelings for him.
e.z: 我對他的感覺仍不確定。

e.e: It is uncertain what his role in the company will be.
e.z: 他在公司將扮演什麼角色還不確定。

e.e: The baby took its first uncertain steps.
e.z: 嬰兒踏出了搖搖晃晃的第一步。

e.e: I told him what I thought of him in no uncertain terms.
e.z: 我毫不客氣地告訴了他我對他的看法。

e.e: There is considerable uncertainty about the company's future.
e.z: 公司的未來存在相當大的不確定性。

e.e: He had an air of uncertainty about him.
e.z: 他給人一種猶豫不決的感覺。

e.e: The heat was becoming unbearable.
e.z: 炎熱變得難以忍受。

e.e: He's been unbearable since he won that prize.
e.z: 自從贏得那個獎項後，他就變得讓人受不了。

d.m: 无礼貌的；失礼的；粗鲁的

e.e: The manner in which she received him was calculated to a nicety to seem cool without being uncivil.
e.z: 她接待他时始终准确地把握好分寸，看似冷淡，却不失礼。

d.m: 地图上没标明的；未经勘测的；未知的

e.e: The ship hit an uncharted rock.
e.z: 船撞上了一塊海圖上未標示的岩石。

e.e: They set off into the country's uncharted interior.
e.z: 他們出發前往該國未經探勘的內陸地區。

e.e: Joey was like an uncle to us.
e.z: 喬伊對我們來說就像叔叔一樣。

e.e: He was the youngest son of Edward III and uncle to Richard II.
e.z: 他是愛德華三世最小的兒子，也是理查二世的叔父。

e.e: The celebrant of the Mass was Rev. Martin Doyle, uncle of the bride.
e.z: 主持彌撒的神父是馬丁·多伊爾，新娘的叔叔。

e.e: The uncle who lives opposite my parents is always so warm and friendly.
e.z: 住在我父母對面的那位叔叔總是那麼熱情友善。

e.e: Press here and Bob's your uncle! It's disappeared.
e.z: 按這裡，搞定！它就不見了。

col.zh: 山姆大叔（指美国或美国政府）

e.e: My opinion remains unchanged.
e.z: 我的意見保持不變。

e.e: They will play an unchanged team in Saturday’s game.
e.z: 他們在週六的比賽中將派出不變的陣容。

e.e: The school appeared essentially unchanged since my day.
e.z: 這所學校從我那個時代以來，基本上沒有改變。

e.e: If there is a check next to it, click it to uncheck.
e.z: 如果它的前面被选中，点击取消选中。

e.e: Our plans are unclear at the moment.
e.z: 我們的計畫目前還不明確。

e.e: It is unclear whether there is any damage.
e.z: 目前還不清楚是否有任何損壞。

e.e: I'm unclear about what you want me to do.
e.z: 我不清楚你要我做什麼。

d.m: 不寻常的；不常见的；极度的

e.e: Side effects from the drug are uncommon.
e.z: 這種藥物的副作用不常見。

e.e: Red squirrels are uncommon in England.
e.z: 紅松鼠在英格蘭並不常見。

e.e: She showed uncommon pleasure at his arrival.
e.z: 她對他的到來表現出異常的喜悅。

e.e: The headphones can be uncomfortable to wear.
e.z: 這款耳機戴起來可能不舒服。

e.e: I couldn't sleep because the bed was so uncomfortable.
e.z: 因為床太不舒服，我睡不著。

e.e: I find these chairs incredibly uncomfortable.
e.z: 我覺得這些椅子極度不舒服。

e.e: I was sitting in an extremely uncomfortable position.
e.z: 我當時坐的姿勢極不舒服。

e.e: It was uncomfortable to walk for long periods of time.
e.z: 長時間走路很不舒服。

syn.m: 不自在的 心神不安的 不...

e.e: I support her unconditionally.
e.z: 我無條件支持她。

e.e: They found him lying unconscious on the floor.
e.z: 他們發現他昏迷不醒地躺在地板上。

e.e: She fell unconscious after breathing in the gas.
e.z: 她吸入氣體後昏了過去。

e.e: It was a powerful sedative that would render them unconscious within minutes.
e.z: 這是一種強效鎮靜劑，能在幾分鐘內使他們失去知覺。

e.e: Freud sought to unlock the workings of the unconscious mind.
e.z: 佛洛伊德試圖解開潛意識的運作機制。

e.e: The brochure is full of unconscious humour.
e.z: 這本手冊充滿了無意識的幽默。

e.e: He looks uncommonly like a younger version of his father.
e.z: 他長得異常像他父親年輕時的模樣。

e.e: Not uncommonly, there is a great deal of rain in August.
e.z: 八月經常下很多雨，這並不罕見。

d.m: 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的

e.e: They appealed for the immediate and unconditional release of all political prisoners.
e.z: 他們呼籲立即無條件釋放所有政治犯。

e.e: They demanded the unconditional withdrawal of military forces.
e.z: 他們要求軍隊無條件撤離。

d.m: 无法管束的；控制不住的

e.e: I had an uncontrollable urge to laugh.
e.z: 我有一股無法控制的想笑的衝動。

e.e: That child is uncontrollable.
e.z: 那個孩子完全不受控制。

e.e: They were all victims of her uncontrollable temper.
e.z: 他們都是她無法控制脾氣的受害者。

e.e: Perhaps, unconsciously, I've done something to offend her.
e.z: 也許，我無意中做了什麼冒犯了她。

e.e: Uncover the pan and let the soup simmer.
e.z: 打開鍋蓋，讓湯慢燉。

e.e: Police have uncovered a plot to kidnap the President's son.
e.z: 警方發現了一起綁架總統兒子的陰謀。

e.e: It will be difficult to uncover the truth.
e.z: 要揭露真相將會很困難。

e.e: Archaeologists have uncovered an entire Roman city.
e.z: 考古學家發掘出了一整座羅馬城市。

d.m: 非传统的；不合惯例的；非常规的

e.e: The magazine describes him as having unconventional good looks.
e.z: 這本雜誌形容他擁有非傳統的俊美外貌。

d.m: 不可否认的；无可辩驳的

e.e: It is an undeniable fact that crime is increasing.
e.z: 犯罪率正在上升，這是無可否認的事實。

e.e: The link between poverty and bad health is undeniable.
e.z: 貧窮與健康不佳之間的關聯是無可否認的。

e.e: We should learn from her undaunted spirits.
e.z: 我们应该学习她那种不屈不挠的精神。

e.e: He continued the climb, undaunted by his fall.
e.z: 他跌下来也并未气馁，继续攀登。

e.e: It was undaunted of him to go there alone.
e.z: 他一个人去，真是勇敢。

e.e: You solve problems in a practical, uncomplicated manner.
e.z: 你擅以实际而不复杂的方式解决问题。

e.e: My relationship with Sam Huntington, however, was uncomplicated.
e.z: 我和亨廷顿先生的关系，却一点也不复杂。

e.e: He seemed undaunted by all the opposition to his idea.
e.z: 他似乎對自己想法所面臨的所有反對意見毫不畏懼。

d.m: 得不到的；没空的；不能利用的

e.e: Such luxuries are unavailable to ordinary people.
e.z: 這類奢侈品是普通人無法獲得的。

e.e: He had underdeveloped lungs, like a premature baby.
e.z: 它像一个早产的婴儿，肺部发育不全。

e.e: In rare cases, these organs are underdeveloped or missing.
e.z: 在罕见的案例里，这些器官发育不良或缺乏。

e.e: Lumbering is very important in some underdeveloped countries.
e.z: 在一些不发达的国家，伐木业十分重要。

d.m: 削弱；廉价出售或工作；从下边切

e.e: We were able to undercut our European rivals by 5%.
e.z: 我們能夠比歐洲競爭對手低5%的價格。

e.e: Some members of the board were trying to undercut the chairman's authority.
e.z: 董事會的一些成員試圖削弱主席的權威。

d.m: 不可否认地，不可辩驳地

e.e: He is, undeniably, an excellent player.
e.z: 無可否認地，他是一位出色的球員。

e.e: They carried out a series of underground nuclear tests.
e.z: 他們進行了一系列地下核試驗。

e.e: The changes will affect all workers, whether underground or legal.
e.z: 這些變革將影響所有勞工，無論是地下還是合法的。

e.e: The party was originally formed as an underground organization in 1987.
e.z: 該黨最初於1987年成立為一個地下組織。

e.e: She teaches physics at undergraduate level.
e.z: 她在大學部教授物理。

d.m: 低于；在 ... 下；在 ... 内

e.e: The dog squeezed under the gate and ran into the road.
e.z: 那隻狗從大門下擠過去，跑到了路上。

e.e: The boat lay under several feet of water.
e.z: 那艘船沉在幾英尺深的水下。

e.e: Nobody under 18 is allowed to buy alcohol.
e.z: 未滿18歲者不得購買酒精飲料。

e.e: The wall collapsed under the strain.
e.z: 牆壁在壓力下倒塌了。

e.e: I've been feeling under stress lately.
e.z: 我最近一直感到壓力很大。

e.e: The drug is currently undergoing trials in America.
e.z: 這種藥物目前正在美國進行試驗。

d.m: 从事秘密工作的；秘密的

e.e: The scandal was revealed after months of undercover work by journalists.
e.z: 這起醜聞是在記者數月的臥底工作後被揭露的。

e.e: He dishes out orders to his underlings.
e.z: 他對手下發號施令。

d.m: 潜在的；隐含的；在下面的

e.e: The underlying assumption is that the amount of money available is limited.
e.z: 基本假設是可用資金有限。

e.e: Unemployment may be an underlying cause of the rising crime rate.
e.z: 失業可能是犯罪率上升的根本原因。

d.m: 位于 ... 之下；成为 ... 的基础；[经]优先于

e.e: These ideas underlie much of his work.
e.z: 這些想法是他許多作品的基礎。

e.e: It is a principle that underlies all the party's policies.
e.z: 這是該政黨所有政策背後的原則。

e.e: We underestimated the time it would take to get there.
e.z: 我們低估了到達那裡所需的時間。

e.e: The statistics seriously underestimate the number of people affected.
e.z: 這些統計數據嚴重低估了受影響的人數。

e.e: We underestimated how long it would take.
e.z: 我們低估了需要花費的時間。

e.e: Never underestimate your opponent.
e.z: 永遠不要低估你的對手。

e.e: Their ability should not be underestimated.
e.z: 他們的能力不應被低估。

e.e: The coin rolled underneath the piano.
e.z: 硬幣滾到了鋼琴下面。

e.e: This jacket's too big, even with a sweater underneath.
e.z: 這件夾克太大了，即使裡面穿了毛衣也一樣。

e.e: Underneath her cool exterior she was really very frightened.
e.z: 在她冷靜的外表下，其實非常害怕。

e.e: He seems bad-tempered, but he's very soft-hearted underneath.
e.z: 他看起來脾氣不好，但內心其實很心軟。

e.e: She didn't understand the form she was signing.
e.z: 她不了解她正在簽署的表格。

e.e: His accent made him difficult to understand.
e.z: 他的口音讓人難以理解。

e.e: I'm not sure that I understand. Go over it again.
e.z: 我不太確定我理解了。再講一遍。

e.e: I don't understand what he's saying.
e.z: 我不懂他在說什麼。

e.e: Doctors still don't understand much about the disease.
e.z: 醫生對這種疾病仍然了解不多。

d.m: 地下通道；高架桥下通道或路段

e.e: Don't walk across the street,it's safer to take the underpass.
e.z: 不要穿越马路，从地下道走比较安全。

d.m: 划线于；强调；提供伴奏乐

e.e: The word ‘not’ was heavily underscored.
e.z: 「not」這個詞被重重地劃了底線。

e.e: His speech underscored the need for a clear policy.
e.z: 他的演講強調了明確政策的需要。

e.e: Her question underscored how little she understood him.
e.z: 她的問題凸顯了她有多不了解他。

e.e: The report underscored that the project enjoyed considerable support in both countries.
e.z: 報告強調該計畫在兩國都獲得了相當大的支持。

e.e: It should be underscored that these are only preliminary findings.
e.z: 應該強調的是，這些只是初步發現。

d.m: 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；在...下挖

e.z: 我們對球隊的信心因他們最近的失利而嚴重動搖。

e.e: This crisis has undermined his position.
e.z: 這場危機削弱了他的地位。

e.e: Recent changes have undermined teachers’ morale.
e.z: 最近的變化打擊了教師的士氣。

e.e: The director saw this move as an attempt to undermine his authority.
e.z: 導演認為此舉是試圖削弱他的權威。

e.e: It's all a plot to undermine me.
e.z: 這全是個要搞垮我的陰謀。

d.m: 未耕作的；未开垦的；无教养的

e.e: He was astonished at the uncultivated desolation.
e.z: 他吃惊的瞧着久未耕作的荒野。

e.e: Not a single hectare of land is left uncultivated in our village.
e.z: 我们村没有一亩荒废的土地。

e.e: The settlers carved out a new nation from the uncultivated country.
e.z: 移民们在这块未开垦的土地上创建了一个新的国家。

d.m: 轻描淡写；有保留地陈述

e.z: 他的電影總是傾向於含蓄和低調。

e.e: They were understandably disappointed with the result.
e.z: 他們對結果感到失望是可以理解的。

e.e: She was concerned about his disappearance, and understandably so.
e.z: 她對他的失蹤感到擔憂，這完全可以理解。

e.e: He is, understandably enough, being more cautious this time.
e.z: 這次他更加謹慎，這完全可以理解。

e.e: It was an understandable mistake to make.
e.z: 這是個可以理解的錯誤。

e.e: Warning notices must be readily understandable.
e.z: 警告標誌必須易於理解。

e.e: Most of the students have a sound understanding of English grammar.
e.z: 大多數學生對英語語法有扎實的理解。

e.e: We must tackle the problem with sympathy and understanding.
e.z: 我們必須以同情和理解來處理這個問題。

e.e: Try to show a little more understanding.
e.z: 試著表現出多一點體諒。

e.e: I think I've reached an understanding with my mother.
e.z: 我想我已經和我母親達成了共識。

e.e: My understanding of the situation is different.
e.z: 我對情況的理解不同。

e.e: The names of the winners are underlined in red.
e.z: 獲勝者的名字用紅線標出。

e.e: The word ‘not’ was heavily underlined.
e.z: 「not」這個詞被重重地劃了底線。

e.e: The report underlines the importance of pre-school education.
e.z: 報告強調了學前教育的重要性。

e.e: Her question underlined how little she understood him.
e.z: 她的問題凸顯了她有多不了解他。

e.e: The report underlined that the project enjoyed considerable support in both countries.
e.z: 報告強調該計畫在兩國都獲得了相當大的支持。

e.e: Preparations are well underway for a week of special events in May.
e.z: 五月份一系列特別活動的準備工作正在順利進行中。

e.e: I overtake the undertaker who takes my stake by mistake.
e.z: 我追上那个误拿我赌注的承办人。

e.e: The corpse was laid out by the undertaker.
e.z: 承办殡葬者准备埋葬尸体。

e.e: Politeness looks well in every man, except an undertaker.
e.z: 殷勤有礼，会使任何人的外表好看，惟有包办殡仪者除外。

e.z: 這個嬰兒出生時體重過輕，情況危險。

e.e: Her daughter was seriously underweight.
e.z: 她的女兒體重嚴重不足。

e.e: She packed one change of underwear.
e.z: 她打包了一套換洗內衣。

e.e: Some mothers can't even afford to buy underwear for their kids.
e.z: 有些母親甚至買不起內衣給孩子。

e.e: He was getting cold standing around in his underwear.
e.z: 他只穿著內衣站在那裡，覺得很冷。

e.e: He ran an import-export business and had underworld contacts in Japan.
e.z: 他經營進出口生意，並與日本的黑社會有聯繫。

e.e: The three-headed dog Cerberus guarded the entrance to the underworld.
e.z: 三頭犬刻耳柏洛斯守衛著冥界的入口。

e.e: The British government ended up underwriting the entire project.
e.z: 英國政府最終為整個項目提供了財務擔保。

e.e: The record company may underwrite the costs of a band’s first tour.
e.z: 唱片公司可能會承擔樂團首次巡演的費用。

e.e: He is interested in buying the club as a commercial undertaking.
e.z: 他有興趣收購這家俱樂部作為一項商業事業。

e.z: 在那個年代，穿越鄉村的旅程是一項危險的任務。

e.z: 房東出具了書面承諾，保證會進行維修。

e.e: They escaped by swimming underwater.
e.z: 他們潛水逃脫了。

e.e: Take a deep breath and see how long you can stay underwater.
e.z: 深吸一口氣，看看你能在水下待多久。

e.e: Like humans, seals can't breathe underwater.
e.z: 和人類一樣，海豹無法在水下呼吸。

e.e: The company has announced that it will undertake a full investigation into the accident.
e.z: 該公司已宣布將對事故進行全面調查。

e.e: He undertook to finish the job by Friday.
e.z: 他承諾在星期五之前完成這項工作。

d.m: 未稀释的；未搀假的；未冲淡的

e.e: I looked back on that time with undiluted pleasure.
e.z: 我以純粹的愉悅回顧那段時光。

d.m: 未开发的；不发达的；未充分发育的

e.e: The island is still undeveloped.
e.z: 这座岛屿未得到充分开发。

e.e: There are many undeveloped countries in Africa.
e.z: 在非洲有许多不发达国家。

e.e: Starvation is a big problem in undeveloped countries.
e.z: 饥饿在不发达国家是个很严重的问题。

e.e: I undid the package and took out the books.
e.z: 我解開包裹，拿出書本。

e.e: He undid most of the good work of the previous manager.
e.z: 他毀掉了前任經理大部分的良好成果。

e.e: Just select ‘Edit’ and ‘Undo’ to cancel the previous action.
e.z: 只要選擇「編輯」和「復原」就能取消上一個動作。

e.e: The team was undone by the speed and strength of their opponents.
e.z: 這支隊伍被對手的速度和力量擊敗。

d.m: 无可置辩的；无异议的；确实的

e.e: The date of the painting is now undisputed.
e.z: 這幅畫的創作日期現在已無爭議。

e.e: She has an undoubted talent as an organizer.
e.z: 她無疑擁有組織者的天賦。

d.m: 解开的；未完成的；毁了的

e.z: 大部分的工作都還沒完成。

d.m: 不庄重的；无威严的；不像样子的

e.z: 為了搶到最好的座位，出現了一場有失體面的爭奪。

d.m: 不自在的 心神不安的 不稳定的；不舒服的

e.e: His presence made her feel uneasy.
e.z: 他的存在讓她感到不安。

e.e: She had an uneasy feeling that something terrible was going to happen.
e.z: 她有一種不安的感覺，覺得即將發生可怕的事情。

e.e: He was beginning to feel distinctly uneasy about their visit.
e.z: 他開始對他們的來訪感到明顯的不安。

e.e: She felt uneasy about leaving the children with them.
e.z: 她對於把孩子交給他們照顧感到不安。

e.e: The two sides eventually reached an uneasy compromise.
e.z: 雙方最終達成了脆弱的妥協。

e.e: There was a growing unease about their involvement in the war.
e.z: 對於他們涉入戰爭一事，不安感日益增加。

e.e: He was unable to hide his unease at the way the situation was developing.
e.z: 他無法隱藏自己對局勢發展的不安。

e.e: That one mistake was his undoing.
e.z: 那一個錯誤就是他的敗因。

e.e: I've been unemployed for 5 months.
e.z: 我已經失業五個月了。

e.e: Thousands of labourers became unemployed with no alternative employment.
e.z: 數千名勞工失業，且沒有其他工作機會。

d.m: 没有阻碍的；没有负担的

e.e: In all cases redistribution is unencumbered.
e.z: 但是，再发布却是没有任何障碍的。

e.e: Trading can be characterized as a pure, unencumbered personal choice with an immediate outcome.
e.z: 交易的特征是纯粹的，没有阻碍的，很快就能出结果的个人选择。

e.e: This will be one of the few times in life that you're unencumbered by work.
e.z: 这可能是你一生中为数不多的几次机会，可以不受工作的约束。

d.m: 不断的；不断重复的；永无止境的

e.e: Hours went by and the desert in front of us was unending.
e.z: 時間流逝，我們面前的沙漠無邊無際。

e.e: They are taking undue advantage of the situation.
e.z: 他們正在不當利用這個情況。

e.z: 這項工作應在沒有不當延誤的情況下進行。

e.e: We did not want to put any undue pressure on them.
e.z: 我們不想對他們施加任何不當壓力。

e.e: Repayments can be made over a long period, without putting undue strain on your finances.
e.z: 還款可以分長期進行，不會對你的財務造成過度負擔。

e.z: 重點是這種經濟模式會導致失業。

e.e: He applied for unemployment insurance and was approved.
e.z: 他申請失業保險並獲得批准。

e.e: Thousands of young people are facing long-term unemployment.
e.z: 數千名年輕人正面臨長期失業。

e.e: He has had long periods of unemployment.
e.z: 他曾長期失業。

e.e: One million people suffered unemployment as a result of the tsunami.
e.z: 有一百萬人因海嘯而失業。

e.e: The budget was unequally distributed between the departments.
e.z: 預算在各部門之間分配不均。

e.e: Women were often treated unequally.
e.z: 女性經常受到不平等的對待。

e.e: The economy has been performing unevenly.
e.z: 經濟表現一直不穩定。

e.e: The teams are unevenly matched.
e.z: 這兩支隊伍實力懸殊。

e.e: The passage was narrow and unevenly floored.
e.z: 通道狹窄且地板不平。

e.e: There is undoubtedly a great deal of truth in what he says.
e.z: 他所說的話無疑有很大一部分是真實的。

d.m: 不犯错误的；一贯准确的；万无一失的

e.e: She had an unerring instinct for a good business deal.
e.z: 她對好的商業交易有準確無誤的直覺。

e.e: He could predict with unerring accuracy what the score would be.
e.z: 他能以精準無誤的準確度預測比分。

e.e: Things took an unexpected turn.
e.z: 事情出現了意想不到的轉折。

e.e: The film has some unexpected twists.
e.z: 這部電影有一些意想不到的轉折。

e.e: The announcement was not entirely unexpected.
e.z: 這個宣布並非完全出乎意料。

e.e: The attack came from a totally unexpected direction.
e.z: 攻擊來自一個完全意想不到的方向。

d.m: 无敌的；无比的；不等同的

e.e: He faced his enemy with unequaled courage.
e.z: 他以无比的勇气面对他的敌人。

d.m: 联合国教育科学文化组织

col.zh: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产

e.e: They had arrived unexpectedly.
e.z: 他們出乎意料地到達了。

e.e: The plane was unexpectedly delayed.
e.z: 飛機意外地延誤了。

e.e: Not unexpectedly, most local business depends on tourism.
e.z: 不意外地，當地大部分商業依賴旅遊業。

e.e: She died unexpectedly of a heart attack.
e.z: 她因心臟病發作意外去世。

e.e: He declared his undying love for her.
e.z: 他向她表達了永恆的愛意。

e.e: If you did, you would have my undying gratitude.
e.z: 如果你這麼做，我會永遠感激你。

e.e: This water is unfit to drink.
e.z: 這水不適合飲用。

e.e: Most of the buildings are unfit to live in.
e.z: 大多數建築物不適合居住。

e.e: They described him as unfit to govern.
e.z: 他們形容他不適合治理國家。

e.e: Many of the houses were condemned as unfit.
e.z: 許多房屋被判定為不適合居住。

e.e: The court claims she is an unfit mother.
e.z: 法院聲稱她是個不稱職的母親。

d.m: 不公平的；(商业上)不正当的

e.e: I was working really long hours, which was unfair on my wife and my kids.
e.z: 我工作時間很長，這對我的妻子和孩子不公平。

e.e: It would be unfair not to let you have a choice.
e.z: 不讓你有選擇權會不公平。

e.e: It seems unfair on him to make him pay for everything.
e.z: 要他支付所有費用似乎對他不公平。

e.e: I don't want to be unfair to anyone, so you'll all get a chance.
e.z: 我不想對任何人偏心，所以你們都有機會。

e.e: Most Americans think it is unfair for the government to take more than 25% of anyone's income in taxes.
e.z: 大多數美國人認為政府從任何人收入中徵收超過25%的稅是不公平的。

e.e: She presented such a cold, unforgiving face to the world.
e.z: 她對外界展現出如此冷漠、不寬容的面孔。

e.e: The island is an unforgiving place in winter.
e.z: 這個島嶼在冬天是個嚴酷的地方。

e.e: The music is what makes the movie so unforgettable.
e.z: 音樂讓這部電影如此難忘。

e.e: Unfortunately, I won't be able to attend the meeting.
e.z: 不幸的是，我無法參加會議。

e.e: I can't make it, unfortunately.
e.z: 我無法出席，真可惜。

e.e: Unfortunately for him, the police had been informed and were waiting outside.
e.z: 對他來說不幸的是，警方已獲報並在外面等候。

e.e: We wanted to have only films from Spain at this year's festival. Unfortunately, however, there weren't enough good ones.
e.z: 我們本想在今年影展只放映西班牙電影，但不幸的是，好片不夠多。

e.e: He was unfortunate to lose in the final round.
e.z: 他在最後一輪輸了，真是運氣不好。

e.e: It was an unfortunate accident.
e.z: 那是一場不幸的意外。

e.e: The unfortunate animal was locked inside the house for a week.
e.z: 那隻可憐的動物被關在屋裡一週。

e.e: She described the decision as ‘unfortunate’.
e.z: 她形容這個決定「令人遺憾」。

e.e: It was unfortunate that he couldn't speak English.
e.z: 可惜他不會說英語。

e.e: There's no need to be so unfriendly towards them.
e.z: 沒必要對他們這麼不友善。

e.e: The report examines the ascent of start-ups and how unicorns are changing.
e.z: 這份報告探討了新創公司的崛起以及獨角獸企業如何改變現狀。

d.m: 不快乐的；不高兴的；不幸福的

e.e: I didn't realize but he was deeply unhappy at that time.
e.z: 我當時沒察覺，但他那時非常不快樂。

e.e: This story has an unhappy ending.
e.z: 這個故事結局不圓滿。

e.e: It makes me very unhappy to see you so miserable.
e.z: 看到你這麼痛苦，讓我很不開心。

e.e: Many people are deeply unhappy about the way the government has handled this matter.
e.z: 許多人對政府處理此事的方式深感不滿。

e.e: He was unhappy at being left out of the team.
e.z: 他因被排除在隊伍之外而感到不悅。

e.e: She felt uneasy in the unfamiliar surroundings.
e.z: 她在陌生的環境中感到不安。

e.e: An unfamiliar sound came from the hall.
e.z: 大廳傳來一個陌生的聲音。

e.e: Please highlight any terms that are unfamiliar to you.
e.z: 請標出任何你不熟悉的術語。

e.e: We were quite unfamiliar with the town.
e.z: 我們對這個城鎮相當不熟悉。

d.m: 未确认的；无法识别的；身份不明的

e.e: An unidentified man shot the President.
e.z: 一个身份不明的人开枪射杀了总统。

e.e: Earlier this week, unidentified gunmen kidnapped a U.S. and a British national in the city of Port Harcourt.
e.z: 这个星期早些时候，身份不明的枪手在哈考特港绑架了一名美国人和一名英国人。

e.e: Dramatic events were about to unfold.
e.z: 戲劇性的事件即將展開。

e.e: He quickly put on his uniform.
e.z: 他迅速穿上制服。

e.e: They wore the standard uniform of the American office worker.
e.z: 他們穿著美國上班族的標準制服。

d.m: 不健康的；有害健康的；病态的或不正常的

e.e: They looked poor and unhealthy.
e.z: 他們看起來貧窮又不健康。

e.e: His eyeballs were an unhealthy yellow.
e.z: 他的眼珠呈現不健康的黃色。

e.e: He had an unhealthy interest in disease and death.
e.z: 他對疾病和死亡有著不健康的興趣。

d.m: 缺乏某种特定知识和经验的；不谙此道的
缺乏某种特定经验的人

e.e: The detailed notes in each chapter offer support to the uninitiated reader.
e.z: 每章中的詳細註解為不熟悉主題的讀者提供了幫助。

e.e: They dismissed the problem as unimportant.
e.z: 他們認為這個問題不重要而不予理會。

e.e: This consideration was not unimportant.
e.z: 這個考量並非無關緊要。

e.e: I was just a young girl from a small town and I felt very unimportant.
e.z: 我只是個來自小鎮的年輕女孩，覺得自己很微不足道。

d.m: 不中断的；不停的；未受干扰的

e.e: We had an uninterrupted view of the stage.
e.z: 我們可以不受阻礙地看到舞台。

e.e: We managed to eat our meal uninterrupted by phone calls.
e.z: 我們順利吃完飯，沒有被電話打擾。

e.e: They had unintentionally provided wrong information.
e.z: 他們無意中提供了錯誤資訊。

e.e: The Franco-German war completed the unification of Germany .
e.z: 普法战争完成了德国的统一。

e.e: If unification is sought on the opposite basis, the country will perish.
e.z: 如果向相反的方面统一，那中国就会亡国。

e.e: The unification of Italy resulted in a single country instead of several kingdoms.
e.z: 意大利统一的结果是出现了一个国家,而不是好几个王国。

e.e: My mum was distant and cold and very uninvolved in my life.
e.z: 我媽媽很疏遠、冷漠，對我的生活不太參與。

d.m: 独特的；独一无二的；稀罕的

e.e: Everyone's fingerprints are unique.
e.z: 每個人的指紋都是獨一無二的。

e.e: Each item has a unique 6-digit code.
e.z: 每個物品都有一個獨特的6位數代碼。

e.e: Her lawyer said the case was unique in French law.
e.z: 她的律師說這個案件在法國法律中是獨特的。

e.e: Saturn's largest moon is unique in having an atmosphere made mostly of nitrogen.
e.z: 土星最大的衛星獨特之處在於其大氣主要由氮組成。

e.e: The vast red sand dunes are what makes this area unique.
e.z: 廣闊的紅色沙丘是這個地區與眾不同的原因。

e.e: The UK, uniquely, has not had to face the problem of mass unemployment.
e.z: 英國獨特地不必面對大規模失業問題。

e.e: Her past experience made her uniquely suited to lead the campaign.
e.z: 她過去的經驗使她特別適合領導這場運動。

e.e: He was a uniquely gifted teacher.
e.z: 他是一位天賦異稟的老師。

e.e: The new leader hopes to unify the country.
e.z: 新領導人希望統一國家。

d.m: (做事、说话)一起；一致行动；(歌唱或演奏)齐声

e.e: They moved in perfect unison.
e.z: 他們以完美的同步行動。

e.e: If the Security Council members act in unison, they may prevent an outbreak of war in the region.
e.z: 如果安理會成員一致行動，他們可能防止該地區爆發戰爭。

e.e: The oboe was in unison with the clarinet.
e.z: 雙簧管與單簧管齊奏。

e.e: It was really quite unintentional.
e.z: 这实在不是有意的。

e.e: If ever I offended you,it was entirely unintentional.
e.z: 无论何时我伤害了你，那完全是无意的。

e.e: Nationalist parties united to oppose the government's plans.
e.z: 民族主義政黨聯合起來反對政府的計劃。

e.e: We will unite in fighting crime.
e.z: 我們將團結一致打擊犯罪。

e.e: A special bond unites our two countries.
e.z: 一種特殊的聯繫將我們兩國團結在一起。

e.e: The two countries united in 1887.
e.z: 這兩個國家於1887年統一。

e.e: She unites keen business skills with a charming personality.
e.z: 她將敏銳的商業技能與迷人的個性結合在一起。

e.e: The cell is the unit of which all living organisms are composed.
e.z: 細胞是所有生物體組成的單位。

e.e: The game's selling price was $15 per unit.
e.z: 該遊戲的售價為每單位15美元。

e.e: Each unit of the course that we completed felt like a real achievement.
e.z: 我們完成的每個課程單元都感覺像是一項真正的成就。

e.e: The present perfect is covered in Unit 8.
e.z: 現在完成時在第八單元中介紹。

e.e: The university is recruiting staff to teach the new units.
e.z: 大學正在招聘教師來教授新的課程單元。

d.m: 联合的；一致的；共同形成的

e.e: We need to become a more united team.
e.z: 我們需要成為一個更團結的團隊。

e.e: They are united in their opposition to the plan.
e.z: 他們一致反對該計劃。

e.e: The two parties were united in insisting on keeping the two regions of the Sudan together.
e.z: 這兩個政黨一致堅持將蘇丹的兩個地區保持在一起。

e.e: The various religious and ethnic groupings were united by their desire to end British rule.
e.z: 各種宗教和種族群體因渴望結束英國統治而團結在一起。

e.e: The EU has sent a clear message that it stands united against terrorism.
e.z: 歐盟發出明確訊息，表示團結一致反對恐怖主義。

d.m: 普遍的；全世界的；宇宙的

e.e: Such problems are a universal feature of old age.
e.z: 這類問題是老年期的普遍特徵。

e.e: Agreement on this issue is almost universal.
e.z: 關於這個問題的共識幾乎是普遍的。

e.e: If society is to exist as a unity, its members must have shared values.
e.z: 如果社會要作為一個整體存在，其成員必須擁有共同的價值觀。

e.e: As far as we know, the entire universe was created in the big bang.
e.z: 就我們所知，整個宇宙是在大爆炸中創造的。

e.e: He lives in a little universe of his own.
e.z: 他活在自己的一個小世界裡。

e.e: A tidal pool is its own little universe, bustling with activity and life.
e.z: 潮池是一個自己的小天地，充滿了活動和生機。

e.e: She had unknowingly broken the rules.
e.z: 她不知不覺地違反了規則。

e.e: She studied at the University of Chicago.
e.z: 她在芝加哥大學學習。

e.e: Both their children are at university.
e.z: 他們的兩個孩子都在上大學。

e.e: This treatment is not universally available.
e.z: 這種治療並非普遍可用。

e.e: The theory does not apply universally.
e.z: 這個理論並不普遍適用。

e.e: The animosity which his remarks provoked was entirely unintended.
e.z: 他的言論引發的敵意完全是無意的。

e.e: Students protest to resist the tyrannic rule of the principal.
e.z: 學生們抗議以抵抗校長的專制統治。

d.m: 解开 ... 的皮带；解除 ... 的束缚；释放

e.e: The government's proposals unleashed a storm of protest in the press.
e.z: 政府的提案在媒體上引發了一場抗議風暴。

d.m: 不像，与…不同；与 ... 平时不同

e.e: Music is quite unlike any other art form.
e.z: 音樂與任何其他藝術形式截然不同。

e.e: Unlike most systems, this one is very easy to install.
e.z: 與大多數系統不同，這個系統非常容易安裝。

e.e: It's very unlike him to be so late.
e.z: 他這麼晚到很不像他。

e.e: You won't get paid for time off unless you have a doctor's note.
e.z: 除非你有醫生的證明，否則請假不會有薪水。

e.e: I won't tell them—not unless you say I can.
e.z: 我不會告訴他們——除非你說可以。

e.e: Unless I'm mistaken, she was back at work yesterday.
e.z: 除非我弄錯了，她昨天已經回去上班了。

e.e: He hasn't got any hobbies—unless you call watching TV a hobby.
e.z: 他沒有任何嗜好——除非你把看電視叫做嗜好。

e.e: I sleep with the window open unless it's really cold.
e.z: 除非天氣真的很冷，否則我睡覺時會開著窗戶。

e.e: It is virtually unknown for foxes to attack anyone.
e.z: 狐狸攻擊人幾乎是聞所未聞的。

e.e: Unknown to me, he had already signed the agreement.
e.z: 我不知道他已經簽署了協議。

e.e: Of course, such an event is very unlikely to happen.
e.z: 當然，這樣的事件非常不可能發生。

e.e: It is extremely unlikely that the new owner would want to make people redundant.
e.z: 新業主想要裁員的可能性極低。

e.e: It looks unlikely that prices will fall.
e.z: 價格下跌的可能性看起來不大。

e.e: He seems a most unlikely candidate for the job.
e.z: 他看起來是最不可能勝任這份工作的候選人。

e.e: They have built hotels in the most unlikely places.
e.z: 他們在最不可能的地方建造了酒店。

e.e: It is unmoral to take advantage of the deformities.
e.z: 利用残疾人是不道德的。

e.e: The divers hoped to unlock some of the secrets of the seabed.
e.z: 潛水員希望揭開海床的一些秘密。

e.e: Drama helps to unlock young people’s creative talents.
e.z: 戲劇有助於釋放年輕人的創造力。

e.e: Have an old phone lying around? Unlock it and keep it as a spare.
e.z: 有閒置的舊手機嗎？解鎖它並留作備用。

e.e: Players complete goals, unlock new levels and progress through the game.
e.z: 玩家完成目標，解鎖新關卡並在遊戲中前進。

e.e: Additional features can be unlocked in-app for $5.99.
e.z: 額外功能可在應用程式內以5.99美元解鎖。

e.e: I unpacked my bags as soon as I arrived.
e.z: 我一到達就打開了行李。

e.e: She unpacked all the clothes she needed and left the rest in the case.
e.z: 她拿出所有需要的衣服，其餘的留在箱子裡。

e.e: She went to her room to unpack.
e.z: 她回到房間去整理行李。

e.e: Unofficial estimates put the figure at over two million.
e.z: 非官方估計數字超過兩百萬。

e.e: The former president paid an unofficial visit to China.
e.z: 前總統對中國進行了非正式訪問。

d.m: (数或量)极大的；无限的；不受限制的

e.e: The ticket gives you unlimited travel for seven days.
e.z: 這張票讓您可以在七天內無限次旅行。

e.e: The court has the power to impose an unlimited fine for this offence.
e.z: 法院有權對此罪行處以無上限罰款。

e.e: You will be allowed unlimited access to the files.
e.z: 您將被允許無限制存取這些檔案。

e.e: The possibilities are unlimited.
e.z: 可能性是無限的。

e.e: Stagflation is a very unpopular buzz word in the business world.
e.z: 滞胀是商界不受欢迎的时髦词语。

e.e: Unpopular as red has been in the past, at the moment it is a favorite hair style.
e.z: 过去红色不受欢迎

e.e: The politician was unpopular with his countryman.
e.z: 这位政治家在他的同胞中并不受欢迎。

e.e: It was an unparalleled opportunity to develop her career.
e.z: 這是一個發展她職業生涯的絕佳機會。

e.e: The book has enjoyed a success unparalleled in recent publishing history.
e.z: 這本書在近代出版史上取得了無與倫比的成功。

d.m: 不可口的；不好吃的；让人不快的

e.e: Only then did I learn the unpalatable truth.
e.z: 直到那時我才得知這個令人難以接受的事實。

e.e: The insects store this chemical in their bodies in order to make themselves unpalatable to predators.
e.z: 這些昆蟲將這種化學物質儲存在體內，讓自己對捕食者來說難以下嚥。

d.m: 使人不愉快的；讨厌的；不合意的

e.e: The minerals in the water made it unpleasant to drink.
e.z: 水中的礦物質讓它喝起來很不舒服。

e.e: It can be unpleasant to sit next to a group of people arguing.
e.z: 坐在一群爭吵的人旁邊可能會令人不愉快。

e.e: It must have been unpleasant for her neighbours to be exposed to the constant loud music.
e.z: 她的鄰居長期暴露在吵鬧的音樂中，一定很不愉快。

e.e: Torrential made conditions unpleasant for both players and spectators.
e.z: 傾盆大雨讓選手和觀眾都感到不適。

e.e: What then took place was a deeply unpleasant attack.
e.z: 隨後發生了一場極不愉快的攻擊事件。

e.e: The situation is unprecedented in modern times.
e.z: 這種情況在現代是前所未有的。

e.e: There were unprecedented scenes of violence in the city’s main square.
e.z: 城市的主要廣場發生了前所未有的暴力場面。

e.e: The union represents five million workers.
e.z: 這個工會代表五百萬名勞工。

e.e: Churchill was not hostile to the continent's attempt at forming a union.
e.z: 邱吉爾並不反對歐洲大陸嘗試組成聯盟。

e.e: The crisis will be discussed as a meeting of African Union leaders this week.
e.z: 這場危機將在本週非洲聯盟領袖會議上討論。

e.e: Their union was blessed with six children.
e.z: 他們的婚姻幸福美滿，育有六個孩子。

e.e: The unpredictable weather in the mountains can make climbing extremely hazardous.
